jobs.name: 玉虚·杂役常服
jobs.detail: Practical restrained work robe: subdued warm stone-grey main cloth, dusty blue-grey narrow collar and belt, an ivory inner collar, very sparse tiny cloud weave at cuffs. Plain linen texture, modest overlapping layers, less ornament than higher ranks. Elegant Chinese Daoist cultivator clothing, not armour.
